references.text: The Lord will gather the exiles of Israel and assemble the scattered from Judah from the four corners of the earth, a parallel to the promise to gather those driven out to the farthest ends of heaven.
The Lord God, who gathers the exiles of Israel, promises to gather even more to those already assembled.
The Lord promises to gather his people from all nations and places where he has driven them, and bring them back.
The Lord will gather his people from all the lands where he has driven them in his anger, and bring them back.
The Lord will seek out his sheep and gather them from all the places they were scattered, and bring them back to their own land.
Nehemiah quotes this promise in his prayer, where the Lord vows to gather the exiles even if they are scattered to the farthest ends of heaven.
Jesus speaks of angels gathering his chosen ones from the four corners of the world, from one end of heaven to the other, as fulfillment of this promise.
The Son of Man will send out his angels and gather his chosen ones from the four corners of the world, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
